name: Phnom Penh International Half Marathon
short_description: A half marathon, with 10 km, 5 km and 2.5 km kids' races, set for 13 June 2027 at Botum Vattey Pagoda Park (Wat Botum Park) in Phnom Penh, Cambodia.
ai_summary: The Phnom Penh International Half Marathon is listed for Sunday 13 June 2027 at Botum Vattey Pagoda Park (Wat Botum Park), near the Royal Palace in Phnom Penh, Cambodia. It is organised by the National Olympic Committee of Cambodia, with Cambodia Events as sponsoring and travel partner, and offers a 21.1 km half marathon, a 10 km, a 5 km fun run and a 2.5 km kids' run. The 14th edition on 14 June 2026 had 5,241 participants from 43 countries.

core_facts.venue: Botum Vattey Pagoda Park (Wat Botum Park), Phnom Penh

pros: Four-hour limit on the 21 km: every timed finisher in 2026 came in under it
Water every 2 km, with a new 2026 course along the riverside and through Koh Pich and Koh Norea
A field of about 5,000 with 21 km, 10 km, 5 km and 2.5 km options
Modest fees, from US$28 for Cambodians and US$45 for foreign runners in 2026
cons: Roads are not fully closed; runners reported traffic and motorbikes on the course
Finisher medals did not arrive until weeks after the 2026 race
Routes for different distances split without clear signs, and one runner took a wrong turn
Entries cannot be refunded, transferred or carried over to the next year

faqs.question: When is the Phnom Penh International Half Marathon taking place?
faqs.answer: The next edition is listed for Sunday 13 June 2027, at Botum Vattey Pagoda Park in Phnom Penh. The race is held each June; the 14th edition was on 14 June 2026, when the half marathon started at 5.30am with a four-hour limit, followed by the 10 km at 5.45am.

faqs.question: What distances can participants choose from?
faqs.answer: Four: a 21.1 km half marathon for runners aged 16 and over, a 10 km for ages 13 and over, a 5 km fun run open to adults and children, and a 2.5 km fun run for children under 12. In 2026 only the half marathon included a finisher's T-shirt; all runners received a medal.

faqs.question: Who is organizing the Phnom Penh International Half Marathon?
faqs.answer: The National Olympic Committee of Cambodia organises the race, according to the 2026 registration page, with Cambodia Events Organization Tourism & Consultant Co., Ltd as sponsoring and travel partner. The 2026 edition celebrated the Queen Mother's 90th birthday and raised funds for Kantha Bopha Children's Hospital.
